title: A conversation at the door
subtitle: Practise a short doorstep conversation about faith and hope.

missionary.label: Missionary
missionary.sceneText: You are visiting homes on a quiet street. You have a few minutes at each door.

christian.label: Christian
christian.sceneText: You are at home on a quiet afternoon when someone comes to the door.
christian.goal: Respond kindly and clearly in your own words.

interactionTrigger.initiatorPrompt: You have arrived at the front door.
interactionTrigger.receiverPrompt: Someone is knocking at your door.

openingDialogue.script: Hello. May I ask you one short question?

questions.title: What gives you hope?
questions.missionaryScript: What gives you hope when life is hard?

christian.hiddenAnswer: I would keep my answer short and clear.

followUps.label: Ask them to add more
followUps.missionaryScript: What would you add to that?

christian.hiddenAnswer: I would add one personal example.

questions.title: What does faith mean to you?
questions.missionaryScript: What does faith mean to you?

christian.hiddenAnswer: I would answer in one or two sentences, in my own words.

conclusion.closingPrompt: Thank you for your time. Have a good afternoon.
conclusion.reflectionPrompt: What would you say differently next time?

sourceNotes: Filler content that keeps the original sample link working in the guided format. No substantive script.
